_note: Protocol = the paper's R code 1:1 (see the YAML header): measured 2026-08-26 on the refactor/lean-fit branch. Paper Sec. 5.3. Counterfactuals are analytic. The Fig. 6 errors are at x_obs in the SCM's raw units, (2, 1.5, 5.0875, -0.5) = noise (2, 1.5, 1.4, -1) pushed through the SCM; the R code's xObs.csv is that point divided by CAREFL's sample sds (6.0104, 1.9114), (2, 1.5, 0.8465, -0.2616); the paper prints (2, 1.5, 0.81, -0.28), slightly off it. Held-out rows are scored next to it because one point is a noisy yardstick. The R run trained on CAREFL's own X.csv with val = train; this repository draws 2500 rows from the same SCM and a separate 5000-row validation draw.

fit_seconds.why: 3x the 2-core CI runner measurement (338 s, 2026-08-31): shared-runner wall clock is noisy, so this is a gross-regression tripwire (a lost no_grad, an accidental O(n^2)), not a benchmark
